name: Will converting a tub to a shower affect my home's resale value?

mainEntity.name: Will converting a tub to a shower affect my home's resale value?

acceptedAnswer.text: Converting a tub to a shower can positively impact your home's resale value, especially if it enhances accessibility or modernizes an outdated bathroom. Many homebuyers, particularly older individuals or those with mobility considerations, prefer a walk-in shower. However, it's generally advisable to retain at least one bathtub in the home, especially if you have a multi-bathroom property, as families with young children often look for a tub. A well-executed conversion that aligns with market preferences is usually a good investment.
acceptedAnswer.description: A well-done conversion can increase resale value by enhancing accessibility or modernizing a bathroom, but retaining at least one bathtub in the home is often recommended.
